content: We evaluate the ability of machine learning methods to identify relevant evidence for questions in the privacy domain. We establish baselines for the subtask of deciding on the answerability (§SECREF33) of a question, as well as the overall task of identifying evidence for questions from policies (§SECREF37). We describe aspects of the question that can render it unanswerable within the privacy domain (§SECREF41).
